summary: The diff adds a new Motoko backend actor with access control and user profile/product APIs, plus a new frontend editor/export flow that supports local draft persistence, PDF/ZIP generation, export downloads, and cover thumbnails. However, several BuildRequest requirements are either not evidenced in the diff (notably backend persistence of product definitions per user, and export-screen deliverable summaries/disabled state), and some unrequested features (user profiles, admin-only product creation, pricing) were introduced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Export screen summarizes generated deliverables for each product (what’s included, file sizes, and a preview thumbnail), includes last-generated timestamp, one-click downloads per product, and disables downloads if not generated; also supports 'Download all products' as a single ZIP containing all three product ZIPs.
missing_requirements.reason: The export screen shows file sizes, a cover thumbnail, a generated date, and a 'Download All Products' button, but the provided (truncated) code does not show an included-files list, explicit disablement/indication for not-yet-generated products, or confirmation that the all-products zip contains three product ZIPs (implementation is in another file and not shown).

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend canister API to store/retrieve each authenticated user’s three product definitions and generation metadata, enforcing per-user isolation; app should sync when authenticated and work local-only when unauthenticated.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend storage is not scoped per user for products/metadata (maps are keyed only by product id Text, not by Principal), product creation is admin-only, and there are no backend methods shown to save/load the user’s three product definitions. Frontend only shows user profile queries/mutations; no product save/load hooks or sync logic is evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Cover images are served as static assets from frontend/public/assets/generated (not through the backend) and included in each product ZIP bundle.
missing_requirements.reason: The code references cover image paths under /assets/generated, but the diff does not include the actual image files under frontend/public/assets/generated, and the ZIP inclusion of the cover image is not evidenced (zip builder implementation is not shown in the provided diff).

hallucinated_features.description: User profile onboarding (name capture) with profile storage APIs and UI dialog.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest focuses on product definitions and generation/export; it does not request user profile creation or a profile setup dialog.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin-only product creation and admin-token based access-control initialization via a secret URL parameter.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest requires per-user product storage with Internet Identity, not an admin-controlled product catalog nor secret-token initialization via URL params.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend ProductDefinition fields include imageUrl and price.
hallucinated_features.reason: The requested product entry fields are title/subtitle/description/modules/prompts/templates/checklists/optional branding; price and imageUrl are not specified as required fields in the BuildRequest.
evidence: backend/main.mo (type ProductDefinition = { name; description; imageUrl; price; })
